5822 // TripCount should not be used after expansion to VPInstructions. Reset to
5823 // poison to avoid dangling references.
5824 if (Plan.getTripCount() == ExpSCEV)
5825 Plan.resetTripCount(Plan.getPoison(ExpSCEV->getScalarType()));
5826 ExpSCEV->eraseFromParent();
5827 }
5828}
5829
5830DenseMap<const SCEV *, Value *>
5831VPlanTransforms::expandSCEVs(VPlan &Plan, ScalarEvolution &SE) {
5832 SCEVExpander Expander(SE, "induction", /*PreserveLCSSA=*/false);
5833
5834 auto *Entry = cast<VPIRBasicBlock>(Plan.getEntry());
5835 BasicBlock *EntryBB = Entry->getIRBasicBlock();
5836 DenseMap<const SCEV *, Value *> ExpandedSCEVs;
5837 // Expand remaining VPExpandSCEVRecipes to IR instructions using SCEVExpander.
5838 for (VPRecipeBase &R : make_early_inc_range(*Entry)) {
5839 auto *ExpSCEV = dyn_cast<VPExpandSCEVRecipe>(&R);
5840 if (!ExpSCEV)
5841 continue;
5842 const SCEV *Expr = ExpSCEV->getSCEV();
5843 Value *Res =
5844 Expander.expandCodeFor(Expr, Expr->getType(), EntryBB->getTerminator());
5845 ExpandedSCEVs[Expr] = Res;
5846 VPValue *Exp = Plan.getOrAddLiveIn(Res);
5847 ExpSCEV->replaceAllUsesWith(Exp);
5848 if (Plan.getTripCount() == ExpSCEV)
5849 Plan.resetTripCount(Exp);
5850 ExpSCEV->eraseFromParent();
5851 }
5852 assert(none_of(*Entry, IsaPred<VPExpandSCEVRecipe>) &&
5853 "all VPExpandSCEVRecipes must have been expanded");
5854 // Add IR instructions in the entry basic block but not in the VPIRBasicBlock
5855 // to the VPIRBasicBlock.
5856 auto EI = Entry->begin();
5857 for (Instruction &I : drop_end(*EntryBB)) {
5858 if (EI != Entry->end() && isa<VPIRInstruction>(*EI) &&
5859 &cast<VPIRInstruction>(&*EI)->getInstruction() == &I) {
5860 EI++;
5861 continue;
5862 }
5863 VPIRInstruction::create(I)->insertBefore(*Entry, EI);
5864 }
5865
5866 return ExpandedSCEVs;
5867}
5868
5869/// Returns true if \p V is VPWidenLoadRecipe or VPInterleaveRecipe that can be
5870/// converted to a narrower recipe. \p V is used by a wide recipe that feeds a
5871/// store interleave group at index \p Idx, \p WideMember0 is the recipe feeding
5872/// the same interleave group at index 0. A VPWidenLoadRecipe can be narrowed to
5873/// an index-independent load if it feeds all wide ops at all indices (\p OpV
5874/// must be the operand at index \p OpIdx for both the recipe at lane 0, \p
5875/// WideMember0). A VPInterleaveRecipe can be narrowed to a wide load, if \p V
5876/// is defined at \p Idx of a load interleave group.
5877/// A live-in or recipe defined outside the loop region can be converted, if it
5878/// is the same across all lanes, or we can create a BuildVector for it.
5879static bool canNarrowLoad(VPSingleDefRecipe *WideMember0, unsigned OpIdx,
5880 VPValue *OpV, unsigned Idx, bool IsScalable) {
5881 VPValue *Member0Op = WideMember0->getOperand(OpIdx);
5882 if (Member0Op->isDefinedOutsideLoopRegions()) {
5883 // Operand matches Member0, broadcast across all fields for both live-ins
5884 // and recipes.
5885 if (Member0Op == OpV)
5886 return true;
5887 // Otherwise distinct per-field VPValues are assembled into a BuildVector.
5888 return !IsScalable && OpV->isDefinedOutsideLoopRegions() &&
5889 OpV->getScalarType() == Member0Op->getScalarType();
5890 }
5891 VPRecipeBase *Member0OpR = Member0Op->getDefiningRecipe();
5892 if (auto *W = dyn_cast<VPWidenLoadRecipe>(Member0OpR))
5893 // For scalable VFs, the narrowed plan processes vscale iterations at once,
5894 // so a shared wide load cannot be narrowed to a uniform scalar; bail out.
5895 return !IsScalable && !W->getMask() && W->isConsecutive() &&
5896 Member0Op == OpV;
5897 if (auto *IR = dyn_cast<VPInterleaveRecipe>(Member0OpR))
5898 return IR->getInterleaveGroup()->isFull() && IR->getVPValue(Idx) == OpV;
5899 return false;
5900}
5901
5902static bool canNarrowOps(ArrayRef<VPValue *> Ops, bool IsScalable) {
5903 SmallVector<VPValue *> Ops0;
5904 auto *WideMember0 = dyn_cast<VPRecipeWithIRFlags>(Ops[0]);
5905 if (!WideMember0)
5906 return false;
5907 for (VPValue *V : Ops) {
5908 if (!isa<VPWidenRecipe, VPWidenCastRecipe>(V))
5909 return false;
5910 auto *R = cast<VPRecipeWithIRFlags>(V);
5911 if (getOpcodeOrIntrinsicID(R) != getOpcodeOrIntrinsicID(WideMember0))
5912 return false;
5913 if (R->getScalarType() != WideMember0->getScalarType())
5914 return false;
5915 if (R->hasPredicate() && R->getPredicate() != WideMember0->getPredicate())
5916 return false;
5917 }
5918
5919 for (unsigned Idx = 0; Idx != WideMember0->getNumOperands(); ++Idx) {
5920 SmallVector<VPValue *> OpsI;
5921 for (VPValue *Op : Ops)
5922 OpsI.push_back(Op->getDefiningRecipe()->getOperand(Idx));
5923
5924 if (canNarrowOps(OpsI, IsScalable))
5925 continue;
5926
5927 if (any_of(enumerate(OpsI), [WideMember0, Idx, IsScalable](const auto &P) {
5928 const auto &[OpIdx, OpV] = P;
5929 return !canNarrowLoad(WideMember0, Idx, OpV, OpIdx, IsScalable);
5930 }))
5931 return false;
5932 }
5933
5934 return true;
5935}
5936
5937/// Returns VF from \p VFs if \p IR is a full interleave group with factor and
5938/// number of members both equal to VF. The interleave group must also access
5939/// the full vector width.
5940static std::optional<ElementCount>
5941isConsecutiveInterleaveGroup(VPInterleaveRecipe *InterleaveR,
5942 ArrayRef<ElementCount> VFs,
5943 const TargetTransformInfo &TTI) {
5944 if (!InterleaveR || InterleaveR->getMask())
5945 return std::nullopt;
5946
5947 Type *GroupElementTy = nullptr;
5948 if (InterleaveR->getStoredValues().empty()) {
5949 GroupElementTy = InterleaveR->getVPValue(0)->getScalarType();
5950 if (!all_of(InterleaveR->definedValues(), [GroupElementTy](VPValue *Op) {
5951 return Op->getScalarType() == GroupElementTy;
5952 }))
5953 return std::nullopt;
5954 } else {
5955 GroupElementTy = InterleaveR->getStoredValues()[0]->getScalarType();
5956 if (!all_of(InterleaveR->getStoredValues(), [GroupElementTy](VPValue *Op) {
5957 return Op->getScalarType() == GroupElementTy;
5958 }))
5959 return std::nullopt;
5960 }
5961
5962 auto IG = InterleaveR->getInterleaveGroup();
5963 if (IG->getFactor() != IG->getNumMembers())
5964 return std::nullopt;
5965
5966 auto GetVectorBitWidthForVF = [&TTI](ElementCount VF) {
5967 TypeSize Size = TTI.getRegisterBitWidth(
5968 VF.isFixed() ? TargetTransformInfo::RGK_FixedWidthVector
5969 : TargetTransformInfo::RGK_ScalableVector);
5970 assert(Size.isScalable() == VF.isScalable() &&
5971 "if Size is scalable, VF must be scalable and vice versa");
5972 return Size.getKnownMinValue();
5973 };
5974
5975 for (ElementCount VF : VFs) {
5976 unsigned MinVal = VF.getKnownMinValue();
5977 unsigned GroupSize = GroupElementTy->getScalarSizeInBits() * MinVal;
5978 if (IG->getFactor() == MinVal && GroupSize == GetVectorBitWidthForVF(VF))
5979 return {VF};
5980 }
5981 return std::nullopt;
5982}
5983
5984/// Returns true if \p VPValue is a narrow VPValue.
5985static bool isAlreadyNarrow(VPValue *VPV) {
5986 if (isa<VPIRValue>(VPV))
5987 return true;
5988 auto *RepR = dyn_cast<VPReplicateRecipe>(VPV);
5989 return RepR && RepR->isSingleScalar();
5990}
5991
5992// Convert the wide recipes defining the VPValues in \p Members feeding an
5993// interleave group to a single narrow variant. The first member is reused as
5994// the narrowed recipe. BuildVectors for live-in operands are inserted into \p
5995// Preheader.
5996static VPValue *narrowInterleaveGroupOp(ArrayRef<VPValue *> Members,
5997 SmallPtrSetImpl<VPValue *> &NarrowedOps,
5998 VPBasicBlock *Preheader) {
5999 VPValue *V = Members.front();
6000 if (NarrowedOps.contains(V))
6001 return V;
6002
6003 if (V->isDefinedOutsideLoopRegions()) {
6004 assert(all_of(Members,
6005 [V](VPValue *M) {
6006 return M->isDefinedOutsideLoopRegions() &&
6007 M->getScalarType() == V->getScalarType();
6008 }) &&
6009 "expected distinct loop-invariant values of matching scalar type");
6010 auto *BV = new VPInstruction(VPInstruction::BuildVector, Members);
6011 Preheader->appendRecipe(BV);
6012 NarrowedOps.insert(BV);
6013 return BV;
6014 }
6015
6016 if (isAlreadyNarrow(V))
6017 return V;
6018
6019 VPRecipeBase *R = V->getDefiningRecipe();
6020 if (isa<VPWidenRecipe, VPWidenCastRecipe>(R)) {
6021 auto *WideMember0 = cast<VPRecipeWithIRFlags>(R);
6022 for (VPValue *Member : Members.drop_front())
6023 WideMember0->intersectFlags(*cast<VPRecipeWithIRFlags>(Member));
6024 for (unsigned Idx = 0, E = WideMember0->getNumOperands(); Idx != E; ++Idx) {
6025 SmallVector<VPValue *> OpsI;
6026 for (VPValue *Member : Members)
6027 OpsI.push_back(Member->getDefiningRecipe()->getOperand(Idx));
6028 WideMember0->setOperand(
6029 Idx, narrowInterleaveGroupOp(OpsI, NarrowedOps, Preheader));
6030 }
6031 return V;
6032 }
6033
6034 if (auto *LoadGroup = dyn_cast<VPInterleaveRecipe>(R)) {
6035 // Narrow interleave group to wide load, as transformed VPlan will only
6036 // process one original iteration.
6037 auto *LI = cast<LoadInst>(LoadGroup->getInterleaveGroup()->getInsertPos());
6038 auto *L = new VPWidenLoadRecipe(*LI, LoadGroup->getAddr(),
6039 LoadGroup->getMask(), /*Consecutive=*/true,
6040 *LoadGroup, LoadGroup->getDebugLoc());
6041 L->insertBefore(LoadGroup);
6042 NarrowedOps.insert(L);
6043 return L;
6044 }
6045
6046 if (auto *RepR = dyn_cast<VPReplicateRecipe>(R)) {
6047 assert(RepR->isSingleScalar() && RepR->getOpcode() == Instruction::Load &&
6048 "must be a single scalar load");
6049 NarrowedOps.insert(RepR);
6050 return RepR;
6051 }
6052
6053 auto *WideLoad = cast<VPWidenLoadRecipe>(R);
6054 VPValue *PtrOp = WideLoad->getAddr();
6055 if (auto *VecPtr = dyn_cast<VPVectorPointerRecipe>(PtrOp))
6056 PtrOp = VecPtr->getOperand(0);
6057 // Narrow wide load to uniform scalar load, as transformed VPlan will only
6058 // process one original iteration.
6059 auto *N = new VPReplicateRecipe(&WideLoad->getIngredient(), {PtrOp},
6060 /*IsUniform*/ true,
6061 /*Mask*/ nullptr, {}, *WideLoad);
6062 N->insertBefore(WideLoad);
6063 NarrowedOps.insert(N);
6064 return N;
6065}
6066
6067std::unique_ptr<VPlan>
6068VPlanTransforms::narrowInterleaveGroups(VPlan &Plan,
6069 const TargetTransformInfo &TTI) {
6070 VPRegionBlock *VectorLoop = Plan.getVectorLoopRegion();
6071
6072 if (!VectorLoop)
6073 return nullptr;
6074
6075 // Only handle single-block loops for now.
6076 if (VectorLoop->getEntryBasicBlock() != VectorLoop->getExitingBasicBlock())
6077 return nullptr;
6078
6079 // Skip plans when we may not be able to properly narrow.
6080 VPBasicBlock *Exiting = VectorLoop->getExitingBasicBlock();
6081 if (!match(&Exiting->back(), m_BranchOnCount()))
6082 return nullptr;
6083
6084 assert(match(&Exiting->back(),
6085 m_BranchOnCount(m_Add(m_VPValue(), m_Specific(&Plan.getVFxUF())),
6086 m_Specific(&Plan.getVectorTripCount()))) &&
6087 "unexpected branch-on-count");
6088
6089 SmallVector<VPInterleaveRecipe *> StoreGroups;
6090 std::optional<ElementCount> VFToOptimize;
6091 for (auto &R : *VectorLoop->getEntryBasicBlock()) {
6092 if (isa<VPDerivedIVRecipe, VPScalarIVStepsRecipe>(&R) &&
6093 vputils::onlyFirstLaneUsed(cast<VPSingleDefRecipe>(&R)))
6094 continue;
6095
6096 // Bail out on recipes not supported at the moment:
6097 // * phi recipes other than the canonical induction
6098 // * recipes writing to memory except interleave groups
6099 // Only support plans with a canonical induction phi.
6100 if (R.isPhi())
6101 return nullptr;
6102
6103 auto *InterleaveR = dyn_cast<VPInterleaveRecipe>(&R);
6104 if (R.mayWriteToMemory() && !InterleaveR)
6105 return nullptr;
6106
6107 // Bail out if any recipe defines a vector value used outside the
6108 // vector loop region.
6109 if (any_of(R.definedValues(), [&](VPValue *V) {
6110 return any_of(V->users(), [&](VPUser *U) {
6111 auto *UR = cast<VPRecipeBase>(U);
6112 return UR->getParent()->getParent() != VectorLoop;
6113 });
6114 }))
6115 return nullptr;
6116
6117 // All other ops are allowed, but we reject uses that cannot be converted
6118 // when checking all allowed consumers (store interleave groups) below.
6119 if (!InterleaveR)
6120 continue;
6121
6122 // Try to find a single VF, where all interleave groups are consecutive and
6123 // saturate the full vector width. If we already have a candidate VF, check
6124 // if it is applicable for the current InterleaveR, otherwise look for a
6125 // suitable VF across the Plan's VFs.
6126 SmallVector<ElementCount> VFs =
6127 VFToOptimize ? SmallVector<ElementCount>({*VFToOptimize})
6128 : to_vector(Plan.vectorFactors());
6129 std::optional<ElementCount> NarrowedVF =
6130 isConsecutiveInterleaveGroup(InterleaveR, VFs, TTI);
6131 if (!NarrowedVF || (VFToOptimize && NarrowedVF != VFToOptimize))
6132 return nullptr;
6133 VFToOptimize = NarrowedVF;
6134
6135 // Skip read interleave groups.
6136 if (InterleaveR->getStoredValues().empty())
6137 continue;
6138
6139 // Narrow interleave groups, if all operands are already matching narrow
6140 // ops.
6141 auto *Member0 = InterleaveR->getStoredValues()[0];
6142 if (isAlreadyNarrow(Member0) &&
6143 all_of(InterleaveR->getStoredValues(), equal_to(Member0))) {
6144 StoreGroups.push_back(InterleaveR);
6145 continue;
6146 }
6147
6148 // For now, we only support full interleave groups storing load interleave
6149 // groups.
6150 if (all_of(enumerate(InterleaveR->getStoredValues()), [](auto Op) {
6151 VPRecipeBase *DefR = Op.value()->getDefiningRecipe();
6152 if (!DefR)
6153 return false;
6154 auto *IR = dyn_cast<VPInterleaveRecipe>(DefR);
6155 return IR && IR->getInterleaveGroup()->isFull() &&
6156 IR->getVPValue(Op.index()) == Op.value();
6157 })) {
6158 StoreGroups.push_back(InterleaveR);
6159 continue;
6160 }
6161
6162 // Check if all values feeding InterleaveR are matching wide recipes, which
6163 // operands that can be narrowed.
6164 if (!canNarrowOps(InterleaveR->getStoredValues(),
6165 VFToOptimize->isScalable()))
6166 return nullptr;
6167 StoreGroups.push_back(InterleaveR);
6168 }
6169
6170 if (StoreGroups.empty())
6171 return nullptr;
6172
6173 VPBasicBlock *MiddleVPBB = Plan.getMiddleBlock();
6174 bool RequiresScalarEpilogue =
6175 MiddleVPBB->getNumSuccessors() == 1 &&
6176 MiddleVPBB->getSingleSuccessor() == Plan.getScalarPreheader();
6177 // Bail out for tail-folding (middle block with a single successor to exit).
6178 if (MiddleVPBB->getNumSuccessors() != 2 && !RequiresScalarEpilogue)
6179 return nullptr;
6180
6181 // All interleave groups in Plan can be narrowed for VFToOptimize. Split the
6182 // original Plan into 2: a) a new clone which contains all VFs of Plan, except
6183 // VFToOptimize, and b) the original Plan with VFToOptimize as single VF.
6184 // TODO: Handle cases where only some interleave groups can be narrowed.
6185 std::unique_ptr<VPlan> NewPlan;
6186 if (size(Plan.vectorFactors()) != 1) {
6187 NewPlan = std::unique_ptr<VPlan>(Plan.duplicate());
6188 Plan.setVF(*VFToOptimize);
6189 NewPlan->removeVF(*VFToOptimize);
6190 }
6191
6192 // Convert InterleaveGroup \p R to a single VPWidenLoadRecipe.
6193 SmallPtrSet<VPValue *, 4> NarrowedOps;
6194 VPBasicBlock *Preheader = Plan.getVectorPreheader();
6195 // Narrow operation tree rooted at store groups.
6196 for (auto *StoreGroup : StoreGroups) {
6197 VPValue *Res = narrowInterleaveGroupOp(StoreGroup->getStoredValues(),
6198 NarrowedOps, Preheader);
6199 auto *SI =
6200 cast<StoreInst>(StoreGroup->getInterleaveGroup()->getInsertPos());
6201 auto *S = new VPWidenStoreRecipe(*SI, StoreGroup->getAddr(), Res, nullptr,
6202 /*Consecutive=*/true, *StoreGroup,
6203 StoreGroup->getDebugLoc());
6204 S->insertBefore(StoreGroup);
6205 StoreGroup->eraseFromParent();
6206 }
6207
6208 // Adjust induction to reflect that the transformed plan only processes one
6209 // original iteration.
6210 VPInstruction *CanIVInc = vputils::findCanonicalIVIncrement(Plan);
6211 Type *CanIVTy = VectorLoop->getCanonicalIVType();
6212 VPBasicBlock *VectorPH = Plan.getVectorPreheader();
6213 VPBuilder PHBuilder(VectorPH, VectorPH->begin());
6214
6215 VPValue *UF = &Plan.getUF();
6216 VPValue *Step;
6217 if (VFToOptimize->isScalable()) {
6218 VPValue *VScale =
6219 PHBuilder.createElementCount(CanIVTy, ElementCount::getScalable(1));
6220 Step = PHBuilder.createOverflowingOp(Instruction::Mul, {VScale, UF},
6221 {true, false});
6222 Plan.getVF().replaceAllUsesWith(VScale);
6223 } else {
6224 Step = UF;
6225 Plan.getVF().replaceAllUsesWith(Plan.getConstantInt(CanIVTy, 1));
6226 }
6227 // Materialize vector trip count with the narrowed step.
6228 materializeVectorTripCount(Plan, VectorPH, /*TailByMasking=*/false,
6229 RequiresScalarEpilogue, Step);
6230
6231 CanIVInc->setOperand(1, Step);
6232 Plan.getVFxUF().replaceAllUsesWith(Step);
6233
6234 removeDeadRecipes(Plan);
6235 assert(none_of(*VectorLoop->getEntryBasicBlock(),
6236 IsaPred<VPVectorPointerRecipe>) &&
6237 "All VPVectorPointerRecipes should have been removed");
6238 return NewPlan;
6239}
6240
6241/// Add branch weight metadata, if the \p Plan's middle block is terminated by a
6242/// BranchOnCond recipe.
6243void VPlanTransforms::addBranchWeightToMiddleTerminator(
6244 VPlan &Plan, ElementCount VF, std::optional<unsigned> VScaleForTuning) {
6245 VPBasicBlock *MiddleVPBB = Plan.getMiddleBlock();
6246 auto *MiddleTerm =
6247 dyn_cast_or_null<VPInstruction>(MiddleVPBB->getTerminator());
6248 // Only add branch metadata if there is a (conditional) terminator.
6249 if (!MiddleTerm)
6250 return;
6251
6252 assert(MiddleTerm->getOpcode() == VPInstruction::BranchOnCond &&
6253 "must have a BranchOnCond");
6254 // Assume that `TripCount % VectorStep ` is equally distributed.
6255 unsigned VectorStep = Plan.getConcreteUF() * VF.getKnownMinValue();
6256 if (VF.isScalable() && VScaleForTuning.has_value())
6257 VectorStep *= *VScaleForTuning;
6258 assert(VectorStep > 0 && "trip count should not be zero");
6259 MDBuilder MDB(Plan.getContext());
6260 MDNode *BranchWeights =
6261 MDB.createBranchWeights({1, VectorStep - 1}, /*IsExpected=*/false);
6262 MiddleTerm->setMetadata(LLVMContext::MD_prof, BranchWeights);
6263}
6264
6265void VPlanTransforms::adjustFirstOrderRecurrenceMiddleUsers(VPlan &Plan,
6266 VFRange &Range) {
6267 VPRegionBlock *VectorRegion = Plan.getVectorLoopRegion();
6268 auto *MiddleVPBB = Plan.getMiddleBlock();
6269 VPBuilder MiddleBuilder(MiddleVPBB, MiddleVPBB->getFirstNonPhi());
6270
6271 auto IsScalableOne = [](ElementCount VF) -> bool {
6272 return VF == ElementCount::getScalable(1);
6273 };
6274
6275 for (auto &HeaderPhi : VectorRegion->getEntryBasicBlock()->phis()) {
6276 auto *FOR = dyn_cast<VPFirstOrderRecurrencePHIRecipe>(&HeaderPhi);
6277 if (!FOR)
6278 continue;
6279
6280 assert(VectorRegion->getSingleSuccessor() == Plan.getMiddleBlock() &&
6281 "Cannot handle loops with uncountable early exits");
6282
6283 // Find the existing splice for this FOR, created in
6284 // createHeaderPhiRecipes. All uses of FOR have already been replaced with
6285 // RecurSplice there; only RecurSplice itself still references FOR.
6286 auto *RecurSplice =
6287 findUserOf<VPInstruction::FirstOrderRecurrenceSplice>(FOR);
6288 assert(RecurSplice && "expected FirstOrderRecurrenceSplice");
6289
6290 // For VF vscale x 1, if vscale = 1, we are unable to extract the
6291 // penultimate value of the recurrence. Instead we rely on the existing
6292 // extract of the last element from the result of
6293 // VPInstruction::FirstOrderRecurrenceSplice.
6294 // TODO: Consider vscale_range info and UF.
6295 if (any_of(RecurSplice->users(),
6296 [](VPUser *U) { return !cast<VPRecipeBase>(U)->getRegion(); }) &&
6297 LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(IsScalableOne,
6298 Range))
6299 return;
6300
6301 // This is the second phase of vectorizing first-order recurrences, creating
6302 // extracts for users outside the loop. An overview of the transformation is
6303 // described below. Suppose we have the following loop with some use after
6304 // the loop of the last a[i-1],
6305 //
6306 // for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
6307 // t = a[i - 1];
6308 // b[i] = a[i] - t;
6309 // }
6310 // use t;
6311 //
6312 // There is a first-order recurrence on "a". For this loop, the shorthand
6313 // scalar IR looks like:
6314 //
6315 // scalar.ph:
6316 // s.init = a[-1]
6317 // br scalar.body
6318 //
6319 // scalar.body:
6320 // i = phi [0, scalar.ph], [i+1, scalar.body]
6321 // s1 = phi [s.init, scalar.ph], [s2, scalar.body]
6322 // s2 = a[i]
6323 // b[i] = s2 - s1
6324 // br cond, scalar.body, exit.block
6325 //
6326 // exit.block:
6327 // use = lcssa.phi [s1, scalar.body]
6328 //
6329 // In this example, s1 is a recurrence because it's value depends on the
6330 // previous iteration. In the first phase of vectorization, we created a
6331 // VPFirstOrderRecurrencePHIRecipe v1 for s1. Now we create the extracts
6332 // for users in the scalar preheader and exit block.
6333 //
6334 // vector.ph:
6335 // v_init = vector(..., ..., ..., a[-1])
6336 // br vector.body
6337 //
6338 // vector.body
6339 // i = phi [0, vector.ph], [i+4, vector.body]
6340 // v1 = phi [v_init, vector.ph], [v2, vector.body]
6341 // v2 = a[i, i+1, i+2, i+3]
6342 // v1' = splice(v1(3), v2(0, 1, 2))
6343 // b[i, i+1, i+2, i+3] = v2 - v1'
6344 // br cond, vector.body, middle.block
6345 //
6346 // middle.block:
6347 // vector.recur.extract.for.phi = v2(2)
6348 // vector.recur.extract = v2(3)
6349 // br cond, scalar.ph, exit.block
6350 //
6351 // scalar.ph:
6352 // scalar.recur.init = phi [vector.recur.extract, middle.block],
6353 // [s.init, otherwise]
6354 // br scalar.body
6355 //
6356 // scalar.body:
6357 // i = phi [0, scalar.ph], [i+1, scalar.body]
6358 // s1 = phi [scalar.recur.init, scalar.ph], [s2, scalar.body]
6359 // s2 = a[i]
6360 // b[i] = s2 - s1
6361 // br cond, scalar.body, exit.block
6362 //
6363 // exit.block:
6364 // lo = lcssa.phi [s1, scalar.body],
6365 // [vector.recur.extract.for.phi, middle.block]
6366 //
6367 // Update extracts of the splice in the middle block: they extract the
6368 // penultimate element of the recurrence.
6369 for (VPRecipeBase &R : make_early_inc_range(
6370 make_range(MiddleVPBB->getFirstNonPhi(), MiddleVPBB->end()))) {
6371 if (!match(&R, m_ExtractLastLaneOfLastPart(m_Specific(RecurSplice))))
6372 continue;
6373
6374 auto *ExtractR = cast<VPInstruction>(&R);
6375 VPValue *PenultimateElement = MiddleBuilder.createNaryOp(
6376 VPInstruction::ExtractPenultimateElement, RecurSplice->getOperand(1),
6377 {}, "vector.recur.extract.for.phi");
6378 for (VPUser *ExitU : to_vector(ExtractR->users())) {
6379 if (auto *ExitPhi = dyn_cast<VPIRPhi>(ExitU))
6380 ExitPhi->replaceUsesOfWith(ExtractR, PenultimateElement);
6381 }
6382 }
6383 }
6384}
6385
6386/// Check if \p V is a binary expression of a widened IV and a loop-invariant
6387/// value. Returns the widened IV if found, nullptr otherwise.
6388static VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe *getExpressionIV(VPValue *V) {
6389 auto *BinOp = dyn_cast<VPWidenRecipe>(V);
6390 if (!BinOp || !Instruction::isBinaryOp(BinOp->getOpcode()) ||
6391 Instruction::isIntDivRem(BinOp->getOpcode()))
6392 return nullptr;
6393
6394 VPValue *WidenIVCandidate = BinOp->getOperand(0);
6395 VPValue *InvariantCandidate = BinOp->getOperand(1);
6396 if (!isa<VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe>(WidenIVCandidate))
6397 std::swap(WidenIVCandidate, InvariantCandidate);
6398
6399 if (!InvariantCandidate->isDefinedOutsideLoopRegions())
6400 return nullptr;
6401
6402 return dyn_cast<VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe>(WidenIVCandidate);
6403}
6404
6405/// Create a scalar version of \p BinOp, with its \p WidenIV operand replaced
6406/// by \p ScalarIV, and place it after \p ScalarIV's defining recipe.
6407static VPValue *cloneBinOpForScalarIV(VPWidenRecipe *BinOp, VPValue *ScalarIV,
6408 VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe *WidenIV) {
6409 assert(Instruction::isBinaryOp(BinOp->getOpcode()) &&
6410 BinOp->getNumOperands() == 2 && "BinOp must have 2 operands");
6411 auto *ClonedOp = BinOp->clone();
6412 if (ClonedOp->getOperand(0) == WidenIV) {
6413 ClonedOp->setOperand(0, ScalarIV);
6414 } else {
6415 assert(ClonedOp->getOperand(1) == WidenIV && "one operand must be WideIV");
6416 ClonedOp->setOperand(1, ScalarIV);
6417 }
6418 ClonedOp->insertAfter(ScalarIV->getDefiningRecipe());
6419 return ClonedOp;
6420}
6421
6422void VPlanTransforms::optimizeFindIVReductions(VPlan &Plan,
6423 PredicatedScalarEvolution &PSE,
6424 Loop &L) {
6425 ScalarEvolution &SE = *PSE.getSE();
6426 VPRegionBlock *VectorLoopRegion = Plan.getVectorLoopRegion();
6427
6428 // Helper lambda to check if the IV range excludes the sentinel value. Try
6429 // signed first, then unsigned. Return an excluded sentinel if found,
6430 // otherwise return std::nullopt.
6431 auto CheckSentinel = [&SE](const SCEV *IVSCEV,
6432 bool UseMax) -> std::optional<APSInt> {
6433 unsigned BW = IVSCEV->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits();
6434 for (bool Signed : {true, false}) {
6435 APSInt Sentinel = UseMax ? APSInt::getMinValue(BW, /*Unsigned=*/!Signed)
6436 : APSInt::getMaxValue(BW, /*Unsigned=*/!Signed);
6437
6438 ConstantRange IVRange =
6439 Signed ? SE.getSignedRange(IVSCEV) : SE.getUnsignedRange(IVSCEV);
6440 if (!IVRange.contains(Sentinel))
6441 return Sentinel;
6442 }
6443 return std::nullopt;
6444 };
6445
6446 VPValue *HeaderMask = VectorLoopRegion->getHeaderMask();
6447 for (VPRecipeBase &Phi :
6448 make_early_inc_range(VectorLoopRegion->getEntryBasicBlock()->phis())) {
6449 auto *PhiR = dyn_cast<VPReductionPHIRecipe>(&Phi);
6450 if (!PhiR || !RecurrenceDescriptor::isFindLastRecurrenceKind(
6451 PhiR->getRecurrenceKind()))
6452 continue;
6453
6454 Type *PhiTy = PhiR->getScalarType();
6455 if (PhiTy->isPointerTy() || PhiTy->isFloatingPointTy())
6456 continue;
6457
6458 // If there's a header mask, the backedge select will not be the find-last
6459 // select.
6460 VPValue *BackedgeVal = PhiR->getBackedgeValue();
6461 auto *FindLastSelect = cast<VPSingleDefRecipe>(BackedgeVal);
6462 if (HeaderMask &&
6463 !match(BackedgeVal,
6464 m_Select(m_Specific(HeaderMask),
6465 m_VPSingleDefRecipe(FindLastSelect), m_Specific(PhiR))))
6466 continue;
6467
6468 // Get the find-last expression from the find-last select of the reduction
6469 // phi. The find-last select should be a select between the phi and the
6470 // find-last expression.
6471 VPValue *Cond, *FindLastExpression;
6472 if (!match(FindLastSelect, m_SelectLike(m_VPValue(Cond), m_Specific(PhiR),
6473 m_VPValue(FindLastExpression))) &&
6474 !match(FindLastSelect,
6475 m_SelectLike(m_VPValue(Cond), m_VPValue(FindLastExpression),
6476 m_Specific(PhiR))))
6477 continue;
6478
6479 // Check if FindLastExpression is a simple expression of a widened IV. If
6480 // so, we can track the underlying IV instead and sink the expression.
6481 auto *IVOfExpressionToSink = getExpressionIV(FindLastExpression);
6482 const SCEV *IVSCEV = vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(
6483 IVOfExpressionToSink ? IVOfExpressionToSink : FindLastExpression, PSE,
6484 &L);
6485 const SCEV *Step;
6486 if (!match(IVSCEV, m_scev_AffineAddRec(m_SCEV(), m_SCEV(Step)))) {
6487 assert(!match(vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(FindLastExpression, PSE, &L),
6488 m_scev_AffineAddRec(m_SCEV(), m_SCEV())) &&
6489 "IVOfExpressionToSink not being an AddRec must imply "
6490 "FindLastExpression not being an AddRec.");
6491 continue;
6492 }
6493
6494 // Determine direction from SCEV step.
6495 if (!SE.isKnownNonZero(Step))
6496 continue;
6497
6498 // Positive step means we need UMax/SMax to find the last IV value, and
6499 // UMin/SMin otherwise.
6500 bool UseMax = SE.isKnownPositive(Step);
6501 std::optional<APSInt> SentinelVal = CheckSentinel(IVSCEV, UseMax);
6502 bool UseSigned = SentinelVal && SentinelVal->isSigned();
6503
6504 // Sinking an expression will disable epilogue vectorization. Only use it,
6505 // if FindLastExpression cannot be vectorized via a sentinel. Sinking may
6506 // also prevent vectorizing using a sentinel (e.g., if the expression is a
6507 // multiply or divide by large constant, respectively), which also makes
6508 // sinking undesirable.
6509 if (IVOfExpressionToSink) {
6510 const SCEV *FindLastExpressionSCEV =
6511 vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(FindLastExpression, PSE, &L);
6512 if (match(FindLastExpressionSCEV,
6513 m_scev_AffineAddRec(m_SCEV(), m_SCEV(Step)))) {
6514 bool NewUseMax = SE.isKnownPositive(Step);
6515 if (auto NewSentinel =
6516 CheckSentinel(FindLastExpressionSCEV, NewUseMax)) {
6517 // The original expression already has a sentinel, so prefer not
6518 // sinking to keep epilogue vectorization possible.
6519 SentinelVal = *NewSentinel;
6520 UseSigned = NewSentinel->isSigned();
6521 UseMax = NewUseMax;
6522 IVSCEV = FindLastExpressionSCEV;
6523 IVOfExpressionToSink = nullptr;
6524 }
6525 }
6526 }
6527
6528 // If no sentinel was found, fall back to a boolean AnyOf reduction to track
6529 // if the condition was ever true. Requires the IV to not wrap, otherwise we
6530 // cannot use min/max.
6531 if (!SentinelVal) {
6532 auto *AR = cast<SCEVAddRecExpr>(IVSCEV);
6533 if (AR->hasNoSignedWrap())
6534 UseSigned = true;
6535 else if (AR->hasNoUnsignedWrap())
6536 UseSigned = false;
6537 else
6538 continue;
6539 }
6540
6541 VPInstruction *RdxResult = cast<VPInstruction>(vputils::findRecipe(
6542 BackedgeVal,
6543 match_fn(m_VPInstruction<VPInstruction::ComputeReductionResult>())));
6544
6545 VPValue *NewFindLastSelect = BackedgeVal;
6546 VPValue *SelectCond = Cond;
6547 if (!SentinelVal || IVOfExpressionToSink) {
6548 // When we need to create a new select, normalize the condition so that
6549 // PhiR is the last operand and include the header mask if needed.
6550 DebugLoc DL = FindLastSelect->getDefiningRecipe()->getDebugLoc();
6551 VPBuilder LoopBuilder(FindLastSelect->getDefiningRecipe());
6552 if (match(FindLastSelect,
6553 m_SelectLike(m_VPValue(Cond), m_Specific(PhiR), m_VPValue())))
6554 SelectCond = LoopBuilder.createNot(SelectCond);
6555
6556 // When tail folding, mask the condition with the header mask to prevent
6557 // propagating poison from inactive lanes in the last vector iteration.
6558 if (HeaderMask)
6559 SelectCond = LoopBuilder.createLogicalAnd(HeaderMask, SelectCond);
6560
6561 if (SelectCond != Cond || IVOfExpressionToSink) {
6562 NewFindLastSelect = LoopBuilder.createSelect(
6563 SelectCond,
6564 IVOfExpressionToSink ? IVOfExpressionToSink : FindLastExpression,
6565 PhiR, DL);
6566 }
6567 }
6568
6569 // Create the reduction result in the middle block using sentinel directly.
6570 RecurKind MinMaxKind =
6571 UseMax ? (UseSigned ? RecurKind::SMax : RecurKind::UMax)
6572 : (UseSigned ? RecurKind::SMin : RecurKind::UMin);
6573 VPIRFlags Flags(MinMaxKind, /*IsOrdered=*/false, /*IsInLoop=*/false,
6574 FastMathFlags());
6575 DebugLoc ExitDL = RdxResult->getDebugLoc();
6576 VPBuilder MiddleBuilder(RdxResult);
6577 VPValue *ReducedIV =
6578 MiddleBuilder.createNaryOp(VPInstruction::ComputeReductionResult,
6579 NewFindLastSelect, Flags, ExitDL);
6580
6581 // If IVOfExpressionToSink is an expression to sink, sink it now.
6582 VPValue *VectorRegionExitingVal = ReducedIV;
6583 if (IVOfExpressionToSink)
6584 VectorRegionExitingVal =
6585 cloneBinOpForScalarIV(cast<VPWidenRecipe>(FindLastExpression),
6586 ReducedIV, IVOfExpressionToSink);
6587
6588 VPValue *NewRdxResult;
6589 VPValue *StartVPV = PhiR->getStartValue();
6590 if (SentinelVal) {
6591 // Sentinel-based approach: reduce IVs with min/max, compare against
6592 // sentinel to detect if condition was ever true, select accordingly.
6593 VPValue *Sentinel = Plan.getConstantInt(*SentinelVal);
6594 auto *Cmp = MiddleBuilder.createICmp(CmpInst::ICMP_NE, ReducedIV,
6595 Sentinel, ExitDL);
6596 NewRdxResult = MiddleBuilder.createSelect(Cmp, VectorRegionExitingVal,
6597 StartVPV, ExitDL);
6598 StartVPV = Sentinel;
6599 } else {
6600 // Introduce a boolean AnyOf reduction to track if the condition was ever
6601 // true in the loop. Use it to select the initial start value, if it was
6602 // never true.
6603 auto *AnyOfPhi = new VPReductionPHIRecipe(
6604 /*Phi=*/nullptr, RecurKind::Or, *Plan.getFalse(), *Plan.getFalse(),
6605 RdxUnordered{1}, {}, /*HasUsesOutsideReductionChain=*/false);
6606 AnyOfPhi->insertAfter(PhiR);
6607
6608 VPBuilder LoopBuilder(BackedgeVal->getDefiningRecipe());
6609 VPValue *OrVal = LoopBuilder.createOr(AnyOfPhi, SelectCond);
6610 AnyOfPhi->setOperand(1, OrVal);
6611
6612 NewRdxResult = MiddleBuilder.createAnyOfReduction(
6613 OrVal, VectorRegionExitingVal, StartVPV, ExitDL);
6614
6615 // Initialize the IV reduction phi with the neutral element, not the
6616 // original start value, to ensure correct min/max reduction results.
6617 StartVPV = Plan.getOrAddLiveIn(
6618 getRecurrenceIdentity(MinMaxKind, IVSCEV->getType(), {}));
6619 }
6620 RdxResult->replaceAllUsesWith(NewRdxResult);
6621 RdxResult->eraseFromParent();
6622
6623 auto *NewPhiR = new VPReductionPHIRecipe(
6624 cast<PHINode>(PhiR->getUnderlyingInstr()), RecurKind::FindIV, *StartVPV,
6625 *NewFindLastSelect, RdxUnordered{1}, {},
6626 PhiR->hasUsesOutsideReductionChain());
6627 NewPhiR->insertBefore(PhiR);
6628 PhiR->replaceAllUsesWith(NewPhiR);
6629 PhiR->eraseFromParent();
6630 }
6631}
