6633namespace {
6634
6635using ExtendKind = TTI::PartialReductionExtendKind;
6636struct ReductionExtend {
6637 Type *SrcType = nullptr;
6638 ExtendKind Kind = ExtendKind::PR_None;
6639};
6640
6641/// Describes the extends used to compute the extended reduction operand.
6642/// ExtendB is optional. If ExtendB is present, ExtendsUser is a binary
6643/// operation.
6644struct ExtendedReductionOperand {
6645 /// The recipe that consumes the extends.
6646 VPWidenRecipe *ExtendsUser = nullptr;
6647 /// Extend descriptions (inputs to getPartialReductionCost).
6648 ReductionExtend ExtendA, ExtendB;
6649};
6650
6651/// A chain of recipes that form a partial reduction. Matches either
6652/// reduction_bin_op (extended op, accumulator), or
6653/// reduction_bin_op (accumulator, extended op).
6654/// The possible forms of the "extended op" are listed in
6655/// matchExtendedReductionOperand.
6656struct VPPartialReductionChain {
6657 /// The top-level binary operation that forms the reduction to a scalar
6658 /// after the loop body.
6659 VPWidenRecipe *ReductionBinOp = nullptr;
6660 /// The user of the extends that is then reduced.
6661 ExtendedReductionOperand ExtendedOp;
6662 /// The recurrence kind for the entire partial reduction chain.
6663 /// This allows distinguishing between Sub and AddWithSub recurrences,
6664 /// when the ReductionBinOp is a Instruction::Sub.
6665 RecurKind RK;
6666 /// The index of the accumulator operand of ReductionBinOp. The extended op
6667 /// is `1 - AccumulatorOpIdx`.
6668 unsigned AccumulatorOpIdx;
6669 unsigned ScaleFactor;
6670 /// Optional blend to represent predication for the block that updates the
6671 /// reduction.
6672 VPBlendRecipe *Blend = nullptr;
6673};
6674
6675// Return the incoming index of the single-use value in the blend, which is
6676// expected to be the predicated reduction update.
6677static std::optional<unsigned>
6678getBlendReductionUpdateValueIdx(VPBlendRecipe *Blend) {
6679 assert(Blend && !Blend->isNormalized() &&
6680 Blend->getNumIncomingValues() == 2 &&
6681 "Expected a non-normalized blend with two incoming values");
6682 bool FirstIncomingHasOneUse = Blend->getIncomingValue(0)->hasOneUse();
6683
6684 // Only the update value should have one use (the blend). The previous
6685 // value should always have at least two uses, the blend and the reduction.
6686 if (FirstIncomingHasOneUse == Blend->getIncomingValue(1)->hasOneUse())
6687 return std::nullopt;
6688 return FirstIncomingHasOneUse ? 0 : 1;
6689}
6690
6691static VPSingleDefRecipe *
6692optimizeExtendsForPartialReduction(VPSingleDefRecipe *Op) {
6693 // reduce.add(mul(ext(A), C))
6694 // -> reduce.add(mul(ext(A), ext(trunc(C))))
6695 const APInt *Const;
6696 if (match(Op, m_Mul(m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue()), m_APInt(Const)))) {
6697 auto *ExtA = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Op->getOperand(0));
6698 Instruction::CastOps ExtOpc = ExtA->getOpcode();
6699 Type *NarrowTy = ExtA->getOperand(0)->getScalarType();
6700 if (!Op->hasOneUse() ||
6701 !llvm::canConstantBeExtended(
6702 Const, NarrowTy, TTI::getPartialReductionExtendKind(ExtOpc)))
6703 return Op;
6704
6705 VPBuilder Builder(Op);
6706 auto *Trunc = Builder.createWidenCast(Instruction::CastOps::Trunc,
6707 Op->getOperand(1), NarrowTy);
6708 Type *WideTy = ExtA->getScalarType();
6709 Op->setOperand(1, Builder.createWidenCast(ExtOpc, Trunc, WideTy));
6710 return Op;
6711 }
6712
6713 // reduce.add(abs(sub(ext(A), ext(B))))
6714 // -> reduce.add(ext(absolute-difference(A, B)))
6715 VPValue *X, *Y;
6716 if (match(Op, m_WidenIntrinsic<Intrinsic::abs>(m_Sub(
6717 m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue(X)), m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue(Y)))))) {
6718 auto *Sub = Op->getOperand(0)->getDefiningRecipe();
6719 auto *Ext = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Sub->getOperand(0));
6720 assert(Ext->getOpcode() ==
6721 cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Sub->getOperand(1))->getOpcode() &&
6722 "Expected both the LHS and RHS extends to be the same");
6723 bool IsSigned = Ext->getOpcode() == Instruction::SExt;
6724 VPBuilder Builder(Op);
6725 Type *SrcTy = X->getScalarType();
6726 auto *FreezeX = Builder.insert(new VPWidenRecipe(Instruction::Freeze, {X}));
6727 auto *FreezeY = Builder.insert(new VPWidenRecipe(Instruction::Freeze, {Y}));
6728 auto *Max = Builder.insert(
6729 new VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe(IsSigned ? Intrinsic::smax : Intrinsic::umax,
6730 {FreezeX, FreezeY}, SrcTy));
6731 auto *Min = Builder.insert(
6732 new VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe(IsSigned ? Intrinsic::smin : Intrinsic::umin,
6733 {FreezeX, FreezeY}, SrcTy));
6734 auto *AbsDiff =
6735 Builder.insert(new VPWidenRecipe(Instruction::Sub, {Max, Min}));
6736 return Builder.createWidenCast(Instruction::CastOps::ZExt, AbsDiff,
6737 Op->getScalarType());
6738 }
6739
6740 // reduce.add(ext(mul(ext(A), ext(B))))
6741 // -> reduce.add(mul(wider_ext(A), wider_ext(B)))
6742 // TODO: Support this optimization for float types.
6743 if (match(Op, m_ZExtOrSExt(m_Mul(m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue()),
6744 m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue()))))) {
6745 auto *Ext = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Op);
6746 auto *Mul = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(Ext->getOperand(0));
6747 auto *MulLHS = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Mul->getOperand(0));
6748 auto *MulRHS = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Mul->getOperand(1));
6749 if (!Mul->hasOneUse() ||
6750 (Ext->getOpcode() != MulLHS->getOpcode() && MulLHS != MulRHS) ||
6751 MulLHS->getOpcode() != MulRHS->getOpcode())
6752 return Op;
6753 VPBuilder Builder(Mul);
6754 auto *NewLHS = Builder.createWidenCast(
6755 MulLHS->getOpcode(), MulLHS->getOperand(0), Ext->getScalarType());
6756 auto *NewRHS = MulLHS == MulRHS
6757 ? NewLHS
6758 : Builder.createWidenCast(MulRHS->getOpcode(),
6759 MulRHS->getOperand(0),
6760 Ext->getScalarType());
6761 auto *NewMul = Mul->cloneWithOperands({NewLHS, NewRHS});
6762 Builder.insert(NewMul);
6763 Op->replaceAllUsesWith(NewMul);
6764 Op->eraseFromParent();
6765 Mul->eraseFromParent();
6766 return NewMul;
6767 }
6768
6769 return Op;
6770}
6771
6772static VPExpressionRecipe *
6773createPartialReductionExpression(VPReductionRecipe *Red) {
6774 VPValue *VecOp = Red->getVecOp();
6775
6776 // reduce.[f]add(ext(op))
6777 // -> VPExpressionRecipe(op, red)
6778 if (match(VecOp, m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue())))
6779 return new VPExpressionRecipe(cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(VecOp), Red);
6780
6781 // reduce.[f]add(neg(ext(op)))
6782 // -> VPExpressionRecipe(op, sub/neg, red)
6783 if (match(VecOp, m_AnyNeg(m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue())))) {
6784 auto *Neg = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(VecOp);
6785 auto *Ext =
6786 cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Neg->getOperand(Neg->getNumOperands() - 1));
6787 return new VPExpressionRecipe(Ext, Neg, Red);
6788 }
6789
6790 // reduce.[f]add([f]mul(ext(a), ext(b)))
6791 // -> VPExpressionRecipe(a, b, mul, red)
6792 if (match(VecOp, m_FMul(m_FPExt(m_VPValue()), m_FPExt(m_VPValue()))) ||
6793 match(VecOp,
6794 m_Mul(m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue()), m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue())))) {
6795 auto *Mul = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(VecOp);
6796 auto *ExtA = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Mul->getOperand(0));
6797 auto *ExtB = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Mul->getOperand(1));
6798 return new VPExpressionRecipe(ExtA, ExtB, Mul, Red);
6799 }
6800
6801 // reduce.fadd(fneg(fmul(fpext(a), fpext(b))))
6802 // -> VPExpressionRecipe(a, b, fmul, fsub, red)
6803 if (match(VecOp,
6804 m_FNeg(m_FMul(m_FPExt(m_VPValue()), m_FPExt(m_VPValue()))))) {
6805 auto *FNeg = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(VecOp);
6806 auto *FMul = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(FNeg->getOperand(0));
6807 auto *ExtA = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(FMul->getOperand(0));
6808 auto *ExtB = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(FMul->getOperand(1));
6809 return new VPExpressionRecipe(ExtA, ExtB, FMul, FNeg, Red);
6810 }
6811
6812 // reduce.add(neg(mul(ext(a), ext(b))))
6813 // -> VPExpressionRecipe(a, b, mul, sub, red)
6814 if (match(VecOp, m_Sub(m_ZeroInt(), m_Mul(m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue()),
6815 m_ZExtOrSExt(m_VPValue()))))) {
6816 auto *Sub = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(VecOp);
6817 auto *Mul = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(Sub->getOperand(1));
6818 auto *ExtA = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Mul->getOperand(0));
6819 auto *ExtB = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Mul->getOperand(1));
6820 return new VPExpressionRecipe(ExtA, ExtB, Mul, Sub, Red);
6821 }
6822
6823 llvm_unreachable("Unsupported expression");
6824}
6825
6826// Helper to transform a partial reduction chain into a partial reduction
6827// recipe. Assumes profitability has been checked.
6828static void transformToPartialReduction(const VPPartialReductionChain &Chain,
6829 VPlan &Plan,
6830 VPReductionPHIRecipe *RdxPhi) {
6831 VPWidenRecipe *WidenRecipe = Chain.ReductionBinOp;
6832 assert(WidenRecipe->getNumOperands() == 2 && "Expected binary operation");
6833
6834 VPValue *Accumulator = WidenRecipe->getOperand(Chain.AccumulatorOpIdx);
6835 auto *ExtendedOp = cast<VPSingleDefRecipe>(
6836 WidenRecipe->getOperand(1 - Chain.AccumulatorOpIdx));
6837
6838 // FIXME: Do these transforms before invoking the cost-model.
6839 ExtendedOp = optimizeExtendsForPartialReduction(ExtendedOp);
6840
6841 // Sub-reductions can be implemented in two ways:
6842 // (1) negate the operand in the vector loop (the default way).
6843 // (2) subtract the reduced value from the init value in the middle block.
6844 // Both ways keep the reduction itself as an 'add' reduction.
6845 //
6846 // The ISD nodes for partial reductions don't support folding the
6847 // sub/negation into its operands because the following is not a valid
6848 // transformation:
6849 // sub(0, mul(ext(a), ext(b)))
6850 // -> mul(ext(a), ext(sub(0, b)))
6851 //
6852 // It's therefore better to choose option (2) such that the partial
6853 // reduction is always positive (starting at '0') and to do a final
6854 // subtract in the middle block.
6855 if ((WidenRecipe->getOpcode() == Instruction::Sub &&
6856 Chain.RK != RecurKind::Sub) ||
6857 (WidenRecipe->getOpcode() == Instruction::FSub &&
6858 Chain.RK != RecurKind::FSub)) {
6859 VPBuilder Builder(WidenRecipe);
6860 Type *ElemTy = ExtendedOp->getScalarType();
6861 VPWidenRecipe *NegRecipe;
6862 if (WidenRecipe->getOpcode() == Instruction::FSub) {
6863 NegRecipe =
6864 new VPWidenRecipe(Instruction::FNeg, {ExtendedOp}, VPIRFlags(),
6865 VPIRMetadata(), DebugLoc::getUnknown());
6866 } else {
6867 auto *Zero = Plan.getZero(ElemTy);
6868 NegRecipe =
6869 new VPWidenRecipe(Instruction::Sub, {Zero, ExtendedOp}, VPIRFlags(),
6870 VPIRMetadata(), DebugLoc::getUnknown());
6871 }
6872 Builder.insert(NegRecipe);
6873 ExtendedOp = NegRecipe;
6874 }
6875
6876 // Check if WidenRecipe is the final result of the reduction. If so, look
6877 // through the Select recipe introduced by tail-folding, otherwise look
6878 // through any Blend recipe introduced by predication for the block.
6879 VPValue *ExitSearch =
6880 Chain.Blend ? cast<VPValue>(Chain.Blend) : cast<VPValue>(WidenRecipe);
6881
6882 VPValue *Cond = nullptr;
6883 VPValue *ExitValue = cast_or_null<VPInstruction>(
6884 findUserOf(ExitSearch, m_Select(m_VPValue(Cond), m_Specific(ExitSearch),
6885 m_Specific(RdxPhi))));
6886
6887 if (Chain.Blend) {
6888 std::optional<unsigned> BlendReductionIdx =
6889 getBlendReductionUpdateValueIdx(Chain.Blend);
6890 assert(BlendReductionIdx &&
6891 Chain.Blend->getIncomingValue(*BlendReductionIdx) == WidenRecipe &&
6892 "Expected blend to contain the reduction update");
6893 VPValue *BlendCond = Chain.Blend->getMask(*BlendReductionIdx);
6894 Cond = ExitValue ? VPBuilder(WidenRecipe)
6895 .createLogicalAnd(Cond, BlendCond,
6896 WidenRecipe->getDebugLoc())
6897 : BlendCond;
6898 }
6899
6900 bool IsLastInChain = RdxPhi->getBackedgeValue() == WidenRecipe ||
6901 RdxPhi->getBackedgeValue() == ExitValue ||
6902 RdxPhi->getBackedgeValue() == Chain.Blend;
6903 assert((!ExitValue || IsLastInChain) &&
6904 "if we found ExitValue, it must match RdxPhi's backedge value");
6905
6906 Type *PhiType = RdxPhi->getScalarType();
6907 RecurKind RdxKind =
6908 PhiType->isFloatingPointTy() ? RecurKind::FAdd : RecurKind::Add;
6909 auto *PartialRed = new VPReductionRecipe(
6910 RdxKind,
6911 RdxKind == RecurKind::FAdd ? WidenRecipe->getFastMathFlagsOrNone()
6912 : FastMathFlags(),
6913 WidenRecipe->getUnderlyingInstr(), Accumulator, ExtendedOp, Cond,
6914 RdxUnordered{/*VFScaleFactor=*/Chain.ScaleFactor});
6915 PartialRed->insertBefore(WidenRecipe);
6916
6917 if (ExitValue)
6918 ExitValue->replaceAllUsesWith(PartialRed);
6919 if (Chain.Blend)
6920 Chain.Blend->replaceAllUsesWith(PartialRed);
6921 WidenRecipe->replaceAllUsesWith(PartialRed);
6922
6923 // For cost-model purposes, fold this into a VPExpression.
6924 VPExpressionRecipe *E = createPartialReductionExpression(PartialRed);
6925 E->insertBefore(WidenRecipe);
6926 PartialRed->replaceAllUsesWith(E);
6927
6928 // We only need to update the PHI node once, which is when we find the
6929 // last reduction in the chain.
6930 if (!IsLastInChain)
6931 return;
6932
6933 // Scale the PHI and ReductionStartVector by the VFScaleFactor
6934 assert(RdxPhi->getVFScaleFactor() == 1 && "scale factor must not be set");
6935 RdxPhi->setVFScaleFactor(Chain.ScaleFactor);
6936
6937 auto *StartInst = cast<VPInstruction>(RdxPhi->getStartValue());
6938 assert(StartInst->getOpcode() == VPInstruction::ReductionStartVector);
6939 auto *NewScaleFactor = Plan.getConstantInt(32, Chain.ScaleFactor);
6940 StartInst->setOperand(2, NewScaleFactor);
6941
6942 // If this is the last value in a sub-reduction chain, then update the PHI
6943 // node to start at `0` and update the reduction-result to subtract from
6944 // the PHI's start value.
6945 if (Chain.RK != RecurKind::Sub && Chain.RK != RecurKind::FSub)
6946 return;
6947
6948 VPValue *OldStartValue = StartInst->getOperand(0);
6949 StartInst->setOperand(0, StartInst->getOperand(1));
6950
6951 // Replace reduction_result by 'sub (startval, reductionresult)'.
6952 VPInstruction *RdxResult = vputils::findComputeReductionResult(RdxPhi);
6953 assert(RdxResult && "Could not find reduction result");
6954
6955 VPBuilder Builder = VPBuilder::getToInsertAfter(RdxResult);
6956 unsigned SubOpc = Chain.RK == RecurKind::FSub ? Instruction::BinaryOps::FSub
6957 : Instruction::BinaryOps::Sub;
6958 VPInstruction *NewResult = Builder.createNaryOp(
6959 SubOpc, {OldStartValue, RdxResult}, VPIRFlags::getDefaultFlags(SubOpc),
6960 RdxPhi->getDebugLoc());
6961 RdxResult->replaceUsesWithIf(
6962 NewResult,
6963 [&NewResult](VPUser &U, unsigned Idx) { return &U != NewResult; });
6964}
6965
6966/// Returns the cost of a link in a partial-reduction chain for a given VF.
6967static InstructionCost
6968getPartialReductionLinkCost(VPCostContext &CostCtx,
6969 const VPPartialReductionChain &Link,
6970 ElementCount VF) {
6971 Type *RdxType = Link.ReductionBinOp->getScalarType();
6972 const ExtendedReductionOperand &ExtendedOp = Link.ExtendedOp;
6973 std::optional<unsigned> BinOpc = std::nullopt;
6974 // If ExtendB is not none, then the "ExtendsUser" is the binary operation.
6975 if (ExtendedOp.ExtendB.Kind != ExtendKind::PR_None)
6976 BinOpc = ExtendedOp.ExtendsUser->getOpcode();
6977
6978 std::optional<llvm::FastMathFlags> Flags;
6979 if (RdxType->isFloatingPointTy())
6980 Flags = Link.ReductionBinOp->getFastMathFlagsOrNone();
6981
6982 auto GetLinkOpcode = [&Link]() -> unsigned {
6983 switch (Link.RK) {
6984 case RecurKind::Sub:
6985 return Instruction::Add;
6986 case RecurKind::FSub:
6987 return Instruction::FAdd;
6988 default:
6989 return Link.ReductionBinOp->getOpcode();
6990 }
6991 };
6992
6993 return CostCtx.TTI.getPartialReductionCost(
6994 GetLinkOpcode(), ExtendedOp.ExtendA.SrcType, ExtendedOp.ExtendB.SrcType,
6995 RdxType, VF, ExtendedOp.ExtendA.Kind, ExtendedOp.ExtendB.Kind, BinOpc,
6996 CostCtx.CostKind, Flags);
6997}
6998
6999static ExtendKind getPartialReductionExtendKind(VPWidenCastRecipe *Cast) {
7000 return TTI::getPartialReductionExtendKind(Cast->getOpcode());
7001}
7002
7003/// Checks if \p Op (which is an operand of \p UpdateR) is an extended reduction
7004/// operand. This is an operand where the source of the value (e.g. a load) has
7005/// been extended (sext, zext, or fpext) before it is used in the reduction.
7006///
7007/// Possible forms matched by this function:
7008/// - UpdateR(PrevValue, ext(...))
7009/// - UpdateR(PrevValue, mul(ext(...), ext(...)))
7010/// - UpdateR(PrevValue, mul(ext(...), Constant))
7011/// - UpdateR(PrevValue, ext(mul(ext(...), ext(...))))
7012/// - UpdateR(PrevValue, ext(mul(ext(...), Constant)))
7013/// - UpdateR(PrevValue, abs(sub(ext(...), ext(...)))
7014///
7015/// Note: The second operand of UpdateR corresponds to \p Op in the examples.
7016static std::optional<ExtendedReductionOperand>
7017matchExtendedReductionOperand(VPWidenRecipe *UpdateR, VPValue *Op) {
7018 assert(is_contained(UpdateR->operands(), Op) &&
7019 "Op should be operand of UpdateR");
7020
7021 // Try matching an absolute difference operand of the form
7022 // `abs(sub(ext(A), ext(B)))`. This will be later transformed into
7023 // `ext(absolute-difference(A, B))`. This allows us to perform the absolute
7024 // difference on a wider type and get the extend for "free" from the partial
7025 // reduction.
7026 VPValue *X, *Y;
7027 if (Op->hasOneUse() &&
7028 match(Op, m_WidenIntrinsic<Intrinsic::abs>(
7029 m_OneUse(m_Sub(m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue(X)),
7030 m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue(Y))))))) {
7031 auto *Abs = cast<VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe>(Op);
7032 auto *Sub = cast<VPWidenRecipe>(Abs->getOperand(0));
7033 auto *LHSExt = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Sub->getOperand(0));
7034 auto *RHSExt = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Sub->getOperand(1));
7035 Type *LHSInputType = X->getScalarType();
7036 Type *RHSInputType = Y->getScalarType();
7037 if (LHSInputType != RHSInputType ||
7038 LHSExt->getOpcode() != RHSExt->getOpcode())
7039 return std::nullopt;
7040 // Note: This is essentially the same as matching ext(...) as we will
7041 // rewrite this operand to ext(absolute-difference(A, B)).
7042 return ExtendedReductionOperand{
7043 Sub,
7044 /*ExtendA=*/{LHSInputType, getPartialReductionExtendKind(LHSExt)},
7045 /*ExtendB=*/{}};
7046 }
7047
7048 std::optional<TTI::PartialReductionExtendKind> OuterExtKind;
7049 if (match(Op, m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue()))) {
7050 auto *CastRecipe = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Op);
7051 VPValue *CastSource = CastRecipe->getOperand(0);
7052 OuterExtKind = getPartialReductionExtendKind(CastRecipe);
7053 if (match(CastSource, m_Mul(m_VPValue(), m_VPValue())) ||
7054 match(CastSource, m_FMul(m_VPValue(), m_VPValue()))) {
7055 // Match: ext(mul(...))
7056 // Record the outer extend kind and set `Op` to the mul. We can then match
7057 // this as a binary operation. Note: We can optimize out the outer extend
7058 // by widening the inner extends to match it. See
7059 // optimizeExtendsForPartialReduction.
7060 Op = CastSource;
7061 } else {
7062 return ExtendedReductionOperand{
7063 UpdateR,
7064 /*ExtendA=*/{CastSource->getScalarType(), *OuterExtKind},
7065 /*ExtendB=*/{}};
7066 }
7067 }
7068
7069 if (!Op->hasOneUse())
7070 return std::nullopt;
7071
7072 VPWidenRecipe *MulOp = dyn_cast<VPWidenRecipe>(Op);
7073 if (!MulOp ||
7074 !is_contained({Instruction::Mul, Instruction::FMul}, MulOp->getOpcode()))
7075 return std::nullopt;
7076
7077 // The rest of the matching assumes `Op` is a (possibly extended) mul
7078 // operation.
7079
7080 VPValue *LHS = MulOp->getOperand(0);
7081 VPValue *RHS = MulOp->getOperand(1);
7082
7083 // The LHS of the operation must always be an extend.
7084 if (!match(LHS, m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue())))
7085 return std::nullopt;
7086
7087 auto *LHSCast = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(LHS);
7088 Type *LHSInputType = LHSCast->getOperand(0)->getScalarType();
7089 ExtendKind LHSExtendKind = getPartialReductionExtendKind(LHSCast);
7090
7091 // The RHS of the operation can be an extend or a constant integer.
7092 const APInt *RHSConst = nullptr;
7093 VPWidenCastRecipe *RHSCast = nullptr;
7094 if (match(RHS, m_WidenAnyExtend(m_VPValue())))
7095 RHSCast = cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(RHS);
7096 else if (!match(RHS, m_APInt(RHSConst)) ||
7097 !canConstantBeExtended(RHSConst, LHSInputType, LHSExtendKind))
7098 return std::nullopt;
7099
7100 // The outer extend kind must match the inner extends for folding.
7101 for (VPWidenCastRecipe *Cast : {LHSCast, RHSCast})
7102 if (Cast && OuterExtKind &&
7103 getPartialReductionExtendKind(Cast) != OuterExtKind)
7104 return std::nullopt;
7105
7106 Type *RHSInputType = LHSInputType;
7107 ExtendKind RHSExtendKind = LHSExtendKind;
7108 if (RHSCast) {
7109 RHSInputType = RHSCast->getOperand(0)->getScalarType();
7110 RHSExtendKind = getPartialReductionExtendKind(RHSCast);
7111 }
7112
7113 return ExtendedReductionOperand{
7114 MulOp, {LHSInputType, LHSExtendKind}, {RHSInputType, RHSExtendKind}};
7115}
7116
7117/// Examines each operation in the reduction chain corresponding to \p RedPhiR,
7118/// and determines if the target can use a cheaper operation with a wider
7119/// per-iteration input VF and narrower PHI VF. If successful, returns the chain
7120/// of operations in the reduction.
7121static std::optional<SmallVector<VPPartialReductionChain>>
7122getScaledReductions(VPReductionPHIRecipe *RedPhiR) {
7123 // Get the backedge value from the reduction PHI and find the
7124 // ComputeReductionResult that uses it (directly or through a select for
7125 // predicated reductions).
7126 auto *RdxResult = vputils::findComputeReductionResult(RedPhiR);
7127 if (!RdxResult)
7128 return std::nullopt;
7129 VPValue *ExitValue = RdxResult->getOperand(0);
7130 match(ExitValue, m_Select(m_VPValue(), m_VPValue(ExitValue), m_VPValue()));
7131
7132 SmallVector<VPPartialReductionChain> Chain;
7133 RecurKind RK = RedPhiR->getRecurrenceKind();
7134 Type *PhiType = RedPhiR->getScalarType();
7135 TypeSize PHISize = PhiType->getPrimitiveSizeInBits();
7136
7137 // Work backwards from the ExitValue examining each reduction operation.
7138 VPValue *CurrentValue = ExitValue;
7139 while (CurrentValue != RedPhiR) {
7140 VPBlendRecipe *Blend = dyn_cast<VPBlendRecipe>(CurrentValue);
7141 std::optional<unsigned> BlendReductionIdx;
7142 if (Blend) {
7143 assert(!Blend->isNormalized() && "Expect Blend not to be normalized.");
7144 if (Blend->getNumIncomingValues() != 2)
7145 return std::nullopt;
7146
7147 BlendReductionIdx = getBlendReductionUpdateValueIdx(Blend);
7148 if (!BlendReductionIdx)
7149 return std::nullopt;
7150
7151 CurrentValue = Blend->getIncomingValue(*BlendReductionIdx);
7152 }
7153
7154 auto *UpdateR = dyn_cast<VPWidenRecipe>(CurrentValue);
7155 if (!UpdateR || !Instruction::isBinaryOp(UpdateR->getOpcode()))
7156 return std::nullopt;
7157
7158 VPValue *Op = UpdateR->getOperand(1);
7159 VPValue *PrevValue = UpdateR->getOperand(0);
7160
7161 // Find the extended operand. The other operand (PrevValue) is the next link
7162 // in the reduction chain.
7163 std::optional<ExtendedReductionOperand> ExtendedOp =
7164 matchExtendedReductionOperand(UpdateR, Op);
7165 if (!ExtendedOp) {
7166 ExtendedOp = matchExtendedReductionOperand(UpdateR, PrevValue);
7167 if (!ExtendedOp)
7168 return std::nullopt;
7169 std::swap(Op, PrevValue);
7170 }
7171
7172 // Look for VPBlend(reduce(PrevValue, Op), PrevValue), where
7173 // reduce is equal to CurrentValue. This can be lowered as
7174 // a conditional reduction by hoisting the select to the inputs.
7175 if (Blend && Blend->getIncomingValue(1 - *BlendReductionIdx) != PrevValue)
7176 return std::nullopt;
7177
7178 Type *ExtSrcType = ExtendedOp->ExtendA.SrcType;
7179 TypeSize ExtSrcSize = ExtSrcType->getPrimitiveSizeInBits();
7180 if (!PHISize.hasKnownScalarFactor(ExtSrcSize))
7181 return std::nullopt;
7182
7183 VPPartialReductionChain Link(
7184 {UpdateR, *ExtendedOp, RK,
7185 PrevValue == UpdateR->getOperand(0) ? 0U : 1U,
7186 static_cast<unsigned>(PHISize.getKnownScalarFactor(ExtSrcSize)),
7187 Blend});
7188 Chain.push_back(Link);
7189 CurrentValue = PrevValue;
7190 }
7191
7192 // The chain links were collected by traversing backwards from the exit value.
7193 // Reverse the chains so they are in program order.
7194 std::reverse(Chain.begin(), Chain.end());
7195 return Chain;
7196}
7197} // namespace
7198
7199void VPlanTransforms::createPartialReductions(VPlan &Plan,
7200 VPCostContext &CostCtx,
7201 VFRange &Range) {
7202 // Find all possible valid partial reductions, grouping chains by their PHI.
7203 // This grouping allows invalidating the whole chain, if any link is not a
7204 // valid partial reduction.
7205 MapVector<VPReductionPHIRecipe *, SmallVector<VPPartialReductionChain>>
7206 ChainsByPhi;
7207 VPBasicBlock *HeaderVPBB = Plan.getVectorLoopRegion()->getEntryBasicBlock();
7208 for (VPRecipeBase &R : HeaderVPBB->phis()) {
7209 auto *RedPhiR = dyn_cast<VPReductionPHIRecipe>(&R);
7210 if (!RedPhiR)
7211 continue;
7212
7213 if (auto Chains = getScaledReductions(RedPhiR))
7214 ChainsByPhi.try_emplace(RedPhiR, std::move(*Chains));
7215 }
7216
7217 if (ChainsByPhi.empty())
7218 return;
7219
7220 // Build set of partial reduction operations and blends for user validation
7221 // and a map of reduction bin ops to their scale factors for scale validation.
7222 SmallPtrSet<VPRecipeBase *, 4> PartialReductionOps;
7223 SmallPtrSet<VPBlendRecipe *, 4> PartialReductionBlends;
7224 DenseMap<VPSingleDefRecipe *, unsigned> ScaledReductionMap;
7225 for (const auto &[_, Chains] : ChainsByPhi)
7226 for (const VPPartialReductionChain &Chain : Chains) {
7227 PartialReductionOps.insert(Chain.ExtendedOp.ExtendsUser);
7228 if (Chain.Blend)
7229 PartialReductionBlends.insert(Chain.Blend);
7230 ScaledReductionMap[Chain.ReductionBinOp] = Chain.ScaleFactor;
7231 }
7232
7233 // A partial reduction is invalid if any of its extends are used by
7234 // something that isn't another partial reduction. This is because the
7235 // extends are intended to be lowered along with the reduction itself.
7236 auto ExtendUsersValid = [&](VPValue *Ext) {
7237 return !isa<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Ext) || all_of(Ext->users(), [&](VPUser *U) {
7238 return PartialReductionOps.contains(cast<VPRecipeBase>(U));
7239 });
7240 };
7241
7242 auto IsProfitablePartialReductionChainForVF =
7243 [&](ArrayRef<VPPartialReductionChain> Chain, ElementCount VF) -> bool {
7244 InstructionCost PartialCost = 0, RegularCost = 0;
7245
7246 // The chain is a profitable partial reduction chain if the cost of handling
7247 // the entire chain is cheaper when using partial reductions than when
7248 // handling the entire chain using regular reductions.
7249 for (const VPPartialReductionChain &Link : Chain) {
7250 const ExtendedReductionOperand &ExtendedOp = Link.ExtendedOp;
7251 InstructionCost LinkCost = getPartialReductionLinkCost(CostCtx, Link, VF);
7252 if (!LinkCost.isValid())
7253 return false;
7254
7255 PartialCost += LinkCost;
7256 RegularCost += Link.ReductionBinOp->computeCost(VF, CostCtx);
7257 // If ExtendB is not none, then the "ExtendsUser" is the binary operation.
7258 if (ExtendedOp.ExtendB.Kind != ExtendKind::PR_None)
7259 RegularCost += ExtendedOp.ExtendsUser->computeCost(VF, CostCtx);
7260 for (VPValue *Op : ExtendedOp.ExtendsUser->operands())
7261 if (auto *Extend = dyn_cast<VPWidenCastRecipe>(Op))
7262 RegularCost += Extend->computeCost(VF, CostCtx);
7263 }
7264 return PartialCost.isValid() && PartialCost < RegularCost;
7265 };
7266
7267 // Validate chains: check that extends are only used by partial reductions,
7268 // and that reduction bin ops are only used by other partial reductions with
7269 // matching scale factors, are outside the loop region or the select
7270 // introduced by tail-folding. Otherwise we would create users of scaled
7271 // reductions where the types of the other operands don't match.
7272 for (auto &[RedPhiR, Chains] : ChainsByPhi) {
7273 for (const VPPartialReductionChain &Chain : Chains) {
7274 if (!all_of(Chain.ExtendedOp.ExtendsUser->operands(), ExtendUsersValid)) {
7275 Chains.clear();
7276 break;
7277 }
7278 auto UseIsValid = [&, RedPhiR = RedPhiR](VPUser *U) {
7279 if (auto *PhiR = dyn_cast<VPReductionPHIRecipe>(U))
7280 return PhiR == RedPhiR;
7281 auto *R = cast<VPSingleDefRecipe>(U);
7282
7283 if (auto *Blend = dyn_cast<VPBlendRecipe>(R))
7284 return Blend == Chain.Blend || PartialReductionBlends.contains(Blend);
7285
7286 return Chain.ScaleFactor == ScaledReductionMap.lookup_or(R, 0) ||
7287 match(R, m_ComputeReductionResult(
7288 m_Specific(Chain.ReductionBinOp))) ||
7289 match(R, m_Select(m_VPValue(), m_Specific(Chain.ReductionBinOp),
7290 m_Specific(RedPhiR)));
7291 };
7292 if (!all_of(Chain.ReductionBinOp->users(), UseIsValid)) {
7293 Chains.clear();
7294 break;
7295 }
7296
7297 // Check if the compute-reduction-result is used by a sunk store.
7298 // TODO: Also form partial reductions in those cases.
7299 if (auto *RdxResult = vputils::findComputeReductionResult(RedPhiR)) {
7300 if (any_of(RdxResult->users(), [](VPUser *U) {
7301 auto *RepR = dyn_cast<VPReplicateRecipe>(U);
7302 return RepR && RepR->getOpcode() == Instruction::Store;
7303 })) {
7304 Chains.clear();
7305 break;
7306 }
7307 }
7308 }
7309
7310 // Clear the chain if it is not profitable.
7311 if (!LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(
7312 [&, &Chains = Chains](ElementCount VF) {
7313 return IsProfitablePartialReductionChainForVF(Chains, VF);
7314 },
7315 Range))
7316 Chains.clear();
7317 }
7318
7319 for (auto &[Phi, Chains] : ChainsByPhi)
7320 for (const VPPartialReductionChain &Chain : Chains)
7321 transformToPartialReduction(Chain, Plan, Phi);
7322}
7323
7324/// If the pointer operand \p Addr of a memory access is an affine AddRec
7325/// w.r.t. \p L with a constant stride, return the stride in units of
7326/// \p AccessTy. Otherwise return std::nullopt.
7327static std::optional<int64_t> getConstantStride(VPValue *Addr, Type *AccessTy,
7328 PredicatedScalarEvolution &PSE,
7329 const Loop *L) {
7330 const SCEV *AddrSCEV = vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(Addr, PSE, L);
7331 auto *AddRec = dyn_cast<SCEVAddRecExpr>(AddrSCEV);
7332 if (!AddRec)
7333 return {};
7334
7335 return getStrideFromAddRec(AddRec, L, AccessTy, /*Ptr=*/nullptr, PSE);
7336}
7337
7338void VPlanTransforms::makeMemOpWideningDecisions(VPlan &Plan, VFRange &Range,
7339 VPRecipeBuilder &RecipeBuilder,
7340 VPCostContext &CostCtx) {
7341 // Collect all loads/stores first. We will start with ones having simpler
7342 // decisions followed by more complex ones that are potentially
7343 // guided/dependent on the simpler ones.
7344 SmallVector<VPInstruction *> MemOps;
7345 for (VPBasicBlock *VPBB :
7346 VPBlockUtils::blocksOnly<VPBasicBlock>(vp_depth_first_shallow(
7347 Plan.getVectorLoopRegion()->getEntryBasicBlock()))) {
7348 for (VPRecipeBase &R : *VPBB) {
7349 auto *VPI = dyn_cast<VPInstruction>(&R);
7350 if (VPI && VPI->getUnderlyingValue() &&
7351 is_contained({Instruction::Load, Instruction::Store},
7352 VPI->getOpcode()))
7353 MemOps.push_back(VPI);
7354 }
7355 }
7356
7357 // Few helpers to process different kinds of memory operations.
7358
7359 // To be used as argument to `VPlanTransforms::runPass` which explicitly
7360 // specified pass name, hence `VPlan &` parameter.
7361 auto ProcessSubset = [&](VPlan &, auto ProcessVPInst) {
7362 SmallVector<VPInstruction *> RemainingMemOps;
7363 for (VPInstruction *VPI : MemOps) {
7364 if (!ProcessVPInst(VPI))
7365 RemainingMemOps.push_back(VPI);
7366 }
7367
7368 MemOps.clear();
7369 std::swap(MemOps, RemainingMemOps);
7370 };
7371
7372 auto ReplaceWith = [&](VPInstruction *VPI, VPRecipeBase *New) {
7373 New->insertBefore(VPI);
7374 if (VPI->getOpcode() == Instruction::Load)
7375 VPI->replaceAllUsesWith(New->getVPSingleValue());
7376 VPI->eraseFromParent();
7377
7378 // VPI has been processed.
7379 return true;
7380 };
7381
7382 auto Scalarize = [&](VPInstruction *VPI) {
7383 return ReplaceWith(VPI, RecipeBuilder.handleReplication(VPI, Range));
7384 };
7385
7386 VPBasicBlock *MiddleVPBB = Plan.getMiddleBlock();
7387 VPBuilder FinalRedStoresBuilder(MiddleVPBB, MiddleVPBB->getFirstNonPhi());
7388 VPlanTransforms::runPass(
7389 "lowerMemoryIdioms", ProcessSubset, Plan, [&](VPInstruction *VPI) {
7390 if (RecipeBuilder.replaceWithFinalIfReductionStore(
7391 VPI, FinalRedStoresBuilder))
7392 return true;
7393
7394 // Filter out scalar VPlan for the remaining idioms.
7395 if (LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(
7396 [](ElementCount VF) { return VF.isScalar(); }, Range))
7397 return false;
7398
7399 if (VPHistogramRecipe *Histogram = RecipeBuilder.widenIfHistogram(VPI))
7400 return ReplaceWith(VPI, Histogram);
7401
7402 return false;
7403 });
7404
7405 // Filter out scalar VPlan for the remaining memory operations.
7406 if (LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(
7407 [](ElementCount VF) { return VF.isScalar(); }, Range))
7408 return;
7409
7410 // If the instruction's allocated size doesn't equal it's type size, it
7411 // requires padding and will be scalarized.
7412 VPlanTransforms::runPass(
7413 "scalarizeMemOpsWithIrregularTypes", ProcessSubset, Plan,
7414 [&](VPInstruction *VPI) {
7415 Instruction *I = VPI->getUnderlyingInstr();
7416 if (hasIrregularType(getLoadStoreType(I), I->getDataLayout()))
7417 return Scalarize(VPI);
7418
7419 return false;
7420 });
7421
7422 if (!RecipeBuilder.prefersVectorizedAddressing()) {
7423 VPlanTransforms::runPass(
7424 "makeVPlanMemOpDecision", ProcessSubset, Plan, [&](VPInstruction *VPI) {
7425 Instruction *I = VPI->getUnderlyingInstr();
7426 bool IsLoad = VPI->getOpcode() == Instruction::Load;
7427 if (RecipeBuilder.isPredicatedInst(I) || !IsLoad ||
7428 !vputils::isUsedByLoadStoreAddress(VPI))
7429 return false;
7430
7431 // Scalarize loads used as addresses, matching the legacy CM. The load
7432 // is single-scalar if the pointer is loop-invariant, otherwise it is
7433 // replicated per-lane. No mask is needed as the load is not
7434 // predicated.
7435 VPValue *Ptr = VPI->getOperand(0);
7436 const SCEV *PtrSCEV =
7437 vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(Ptr, CostCtx.PSE, CostCtx.L);
7438 bool IsSingleScalarLoad =
7439 !isa<SCEVCouldNotCompute>(PtrSCEV) &&
7440 CostCtx.PSE.getSE()->isLoopInvariant(PtrSCEV, CostCtx.L);
7441
7442 ReplaceWith(VPI,
7443 new VPReplicateRecipe(
7444 I, Ptr, /*IsSingleScalar=*/IsSingleScalarLoad,
7445 /*Mask=*/nullptr, *VPI, *VPI, VPI->getDebugLoc()));
7446 return true;
7447 });
7448 }
7449
7450 // Widen unmasked unit-stride consecutive accesses, matching the legacy CM.
7451 VPlanTransforms::runPass(
7452 "widenConsecutiveMemOps", ProcessSubset, Plan, [&](VPInstruction *VPI) {
7453 Instruction *I = VPI->getUnderlyingInstr();
7454 if (RecipeBuilder.isPredicatedInst(I))
7455 return false;
7456
7457 bool IsLoad = VPI->getOpcode() == Instruction::Load;
7458 VPValue *Ptr = VPI->getOperand(!IsLoad);
7459 Type *ScalarTy =
7460 IsLoad ? VPI->getScalarType() : VPI->getOperand(0)->getScalarType();
7461 if (getConstantStride(Ptr, ScalarTy, CostCtx.PSE, CostCtx.L) != 1)
7462 return false;
7463
7464 Type *StrideTy =
7465 Plan.getDataLayout().getIndexType(Ptr->getScalarType());
7466 VPValue *StrideOne = Plan.getConstantInt(StrideTy, 1);
7467 auto *VectorPtr = new VPVectorPointerRecipe(
7468 Ptr, ScalarTy, StrideOne, vputils::getGEPFlagsForPtr(Ptr),
7469 VPI->getDebugLoc());
7470 VectorPtr->insertBefore(VPI);
7471 VPRecipeBase *WidenedR;
7472 if (IsLoad)
7473 WidenedR = new VPWidenLoadRecipe(*cast<LoadInst>(I), VectorPtr,
7474 /*Mask=*/nullptr,
7475 /*Consecutive=*/true, *VPI,
7476 VPI->getDebugLoc());
7477 else
7478 WidenedR = new VPWidenStoreRecipe(
7479 *cast<StoreInst>(I), VectorPtr, VPI->getOperand(0),
7480 /*Mask=*/nullptr, /*Consecutive=*/true, *VPI, VPI->getDebugLoc());
7481 return ReplaceWith(VPI, WidenedR);
7482 });
7483
7484 VPlanTransforms::runPass("delegateMemOpWideningToLegacyCM", ProcessSubset,
7485 Plan, [&](VPInstruction *VPI) {
7486 if (VPRecipeBase *Recipe =
7487 RecipeBuilder.tryToWidenMemory(VPI, Range))
7488 return ReplaceWith(VPI, Recipe);
7489
7490 return Scalarize(VPI);
7491 });
7492}
7493
7494void VPlanTransforms::makeScalarizationDecisions(VPlan &Plan, VFRange &Range) {
7495 if (LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(
7496 [&](ElementCount VF) { return VF.isScalar(); }, Range))
7497 return;
7498
7499 PostOrderTraversal<VPBlockDeepTraversalWrapper<VPBlockBase *>> POT(
7500 Plan.getEntry());
7501 for (VPBasicBlock *VPBB : VPBlockUtils::blocksOnly<VPBasicBlock>(POT)) {
7502 for (VPRecipeBase &R : make_early_inc_range(reverse(*VPBB))) {
7503 auto *VPI = dyn_cast<VPInstruction>(&R);
7504 if (!VPI)
7505 continue;
7506
7507 auto *I = cast_or_null<Instruction>(VPI->getUnderlyingValue());
7508 // Wouldn't be able to create a `VPReplicateRecipe` anyway.
7509 if (!I)
7510 continue;
7511
7512 // If executing other lanes produces side-effects we can't avoid them.
7513 if (VPI->mayHaveSideEffects())
7514 continue;
7515
7516 // We want to drop the mask operand, verify we can safely do that.
7517 if (VPI->isMasked() && !VPI->isSafeToSpeculativelyExecute())
7518 continue;
7519
7520 // Avoid rewriting IV increment as that interferes with
7521 // `removeRedundantCanonicalIVs`.
7522 if (VPI->getOpcode() == Instruction::Add &&
7523 any_of(VPI->operands(), IsaPred<VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe>))
7524 continue;
7525
7526 // Other lanes are needed - can't drop them.
7527 if (!vputils::onlyFirstLaneUsed(VPI))
7528 continue;
7529
7530 auto *Recipe = VPBuilder::createSingleScalarOp(
7531 VPI->getOpcode(), VPI->operandsWithoutMask(), /*Mask=*/nullptr, *VPI,
7532 *VPI, VPI->getDebugLoc(), I);
7533 Recipe->insertBefore(VPI);
7534 VPI->replaceAllUsesWith(Recipe);
7535 VPI->eraseFromParent();
7536 }
7537 }
7538}
7539
7540/// Returns true if \p Info's parameter kinds are compatible with \p Args.
7541static bool areVFParamsOk(const VFInfo &Info, ArrayRef<VPValue *> Args,
7542 PredicatedScalarEvolution &PSE, const Loop *L) {
7543 ScalarEvolution *SE = PSE.getSE();
7544 return all_of(Info.Shape.Parameters, [&](VFParameter Param) {
7545 switch (Param.ParamKind) {
7546 case VFParamKind::Vector:
7547 case VFParamKind::GlobalPredicate:
7548 return true;
7549 case VFParamKind::OMP_Uniform:
7550 return SE->isSCEVable(Args[Param.ParamPos]->getScalarType()) &&
7551 SE->isLoopInvariant(
7552 vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(Args[Param.ParamPos], PSE, L),
7553 L);
7554 case VFParamKind::OMP_Linear:
7555 return match(vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(Args[Param.ParamPos], PSE, L),
7556 m_scev_AffineAddRec(
7557 m_SCEV(), m_scev_SpecificSInt(Param.LinearStepOrPos),
7558 m_SpecificLoop(L)));
7559 default:
7560 return false;
7561 }
7562 });
7563}
7564
7565/// Find a vector variant of \p CI for \p VF, respecting \p MaskRequired.
7566/// Returns the variant function, or nullptr. Masked variants are assumed to
7567/// take the mask as a trailing parameter.
7568static Function *findVectorVariant(CallInst *CI, ArrayRef<VPValue *> Args,
7569 ElementCount VF, bool MaskRequired,
7570 PredicatedScalarEvolution &PSE,
7571 const Loop *L) {
7572 if (CI->isNoBuiltin())
7573 return nullptr;
7574 auto Mappings = VFDatabase::getMappings(*CI);
7575 const auto *It = find_if(Mappings, [&](const VFInfo &Info) {
7576 return Info.Shape.VF == VF && (!MaskRequired || Info.isMasked()) &&
7577 areVFParamsOk(Info, Args, PSE, L);
7578 });
7579 if (It == Mappings.end())
7580 return nullptr;
7581 return CI->getModule()->getFunction(It->VectorName);
7582}
7583
7584namespace {
7585/// The outcome of choosing how to widen a call at a given VF.
7586struct CallWideningDecision {
7587 enum class KindTy { Scalarize, Intrinsic, VectorVariant };
7588 CallWideningDecision(KindTy Kind, Function *Variant = nullptr)
7589 : Kind(Kind), Variant(Variant) {}
7590 KindTy Kind;
7591
7592 /// Set when Kind == VectorVariant.
7593 Function *Variant;
7594
7595 bool operator==(const CallWideningDecision &Other) const {
7596 return Kind == Other.Kind && Variant == Other.Variant;
7597 }
7598};
7599} // namespace
7600
7601/// Pick the cheapest widening for the call \p VPI at \p VF among scalarization,
7602/// vector intrinsic, and vector library variant.
7603static CallWideningDecision decideCallWidening(VPInstruction &VPI,
7604 ArrayRef<VPValue *> Ops,
7605 ElementCount VF,
7606 VPCostContext &CostCtx) {
7607 auto *CI = cast<CallInst>(VPI.getUnderlyingInstr());
7608
7609 // Scalar VFs and calls forced or known to scalarize always replicate.
7610 if (VF.isScalar() || CostCtx.willBeScalarized(CI, VF))
7611 return CallWideningDecision::KindTy::Scalarize;
7612
7613 auto *CalledFn = cast<Function>(
7614 VPI.getOperand(VPI.getNumOperandsWithoutMask() - 1)->getLiveInIRValue());
7615 Type *ResultTy = VPI.getScalarType();
7616 Intrinsic::ID ID = getVectorIntrinsicIDForCall(CI, &CostCtx.TLI);
7617 bool MaskRequired = CostCtx.isMaskRequired(CI);
7618
7619 // Pseudo intrinsics (assume, lifetime, ...) are always scalarized.
7620 if (ID && VPCostContext::isFreeScalarIntrinsic(ID))
7621 return CallWideningDecision::KindTy::Scalarize;
7622
7623 InstructionCost ScalarCost =
7624 VPReplicateRecipe::computeCallCost(CalledFn, ResultTy, Ops,
7625 /*IsSingleScalar=*/false, VF, CostCtx);
7626
7627 Function *VecFunc =
7628 findVectorVariant(CI, Ops, VF, MaskRequired, CostCtx.PSE, CostCtx.L);
7629 InstructionCost VecCallCost = InstructionCost::getInvalid();
7630 if (VecFunc)
7631 VecCallCost = VPWidenCallRecipe::computeCallCost(VecFunc, CostCtx);
7632
7633 // Prefer the intrinsic if it is at least as cheap as scalarizing and any
7634 // available vector variant.
7635 if (ID) {
7636 InstructionCost IntrinsicCost =
7637 VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe::computeCallCost(ID, Ops, VPI, VF, CostCtx);
7638 if (IntrinsicCost.isValid() && ScalarCost >= IntrinsicCost &&
7639 (!VecFunc || VecCallCost >= IntrinsicCost))
7640 return CallWideningDecision::KindTy::Intrinsic;
7641 }
7642
7643 // Otherwise, use a vector library variant when it beats scalarizing.
7644 if (VecFunc && ScalarCost >= VecCallCost)
7645 return {CallWideningDecision::KindTy::VectorVariant, VecFunc};
7646
7647 return CallWideningDecision::KindTy::Scalarize;
7648}
7649
7650void VPlanTransforms::makeCallWideningDecisions(VPlan &Plan, VFRange &Range,
7651 VPRecipeBuilder &RecipeBuilder,
7652 VPCostContext &CostCtx) {
7653 for (VPBasicBlock *VPBB : VPBlockUtils::blocksAs<VPBasicBlock>(
7654 vp_depth_first_shallow(Plan.getVectorLoopRegion()->getEntry()))) {
7655 for (VPRecipeBase &R : make_early_inc_range(*VPBB)) {
7656 auto *VPI = dyn_cast<VPInstruction>(&R);
7657 if (!VPI || !VPI->getUnderlyingValue() ||
7658 VPI->getOpcode() != Instruction::Call)
7659 continue;
7660
7661 auto *CI = cast<CallInst>(VPI->getUnderlyingInstr());
7662 SmallVector<VPValue *, 4> Ops(VPI->op_begin(),
7663 VPI->op_begin() + CI->arg_size());
7664
7665 CallWideningDecision Decision =
7666 decideCallWidening(*VPI, Ops, Range.Start, CostCtx);
7667 LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(
7668 [&](ElementCount VF) {
7669 return Decision == decideCallWidening(*VPI, Ops, VF, CostCtx);
7670 },
7671 Range);
7672
7673 VPSingleDefRecipe *Replacement = nullptr;
7674 switch (Decision.Kind) {
7675 case CallWideningDecision::KindTy::Intrinsic: {
7676 Intrinsic::ID ID = getVectorIntrinsicIDForCall(CI, &CostCtx.TLI);
7677 Type *ResultTy = VPI->getScalarType();
7678 Replacement = new VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe(*CI, ID, Ops, ResultTy, *VPI,
7679 *VPI, VPI->getDebugLoc());
7680 break;
7681 }
7682 case CallWideningDecision::KindTy::VectorVariant: {
7683 // Masked variants take the mask as a trailing parameter, so they have
7684 // one more parameter than the original call's arguments.
7685 if (Decision.Variant->arg_size() > Ops.size()) {
7686 VPValue *Mask = VPI->isMasked() ? VPI->getMask() : Plan.getTrue();
7687 Ops.push_back(Mask);
7688 }
7689 Ops.push_back(VPI->getOperand(VPI->getNumOperandsWithoutMask() - 1));
7690 Replacement = new VPWidenCallRecipe(CI, Decision.Variant, Ops, *VPI,
7691 *VPI, VPI->getDebugLoc());
7692 break;
7693 }
7694 case CallWideningDecision::KindTy::Scalarize:
7695 Replacement = RecipeBuilder.handleReplication(VPI, Range);
7696 break;
7697 }
7698
7699 Replacement->insertBefore(VPI);
7700 VPI->replaceAllUsesWith(Replacement);
7701 VPI->eraseFromParent();
7702 }
7703 }
7704}
7705
7706void VPlanTransforms::convertToStridedAccesses(VPlan &Plan,
7707 PredicatedScalarEvolution &PSE,
7708 Loop &L, VPCostContext &Ctx,
7709 VFRange &Range) {
7710 if (Plan.hasScalarVFOnly())
7711 return;
7712
7713 VPRegionBlock *VectorLoop = Plan.getVectorLoopRegion();
7714 VPValue *I32VF = nullptr;
7715 for (VPBasicBlock *VPBB : VPBlockUtils::blocksOnly<VPBasicBlock>(
7716 vp_depth_first_shallow(VectorLoop->getEntry()))) {
7717 for (VPRecipeBase &R : make_early_inc_range(*VPBB)) {
7718 auto *LoadR = dyn_cast<VPWidenLoadRecipe>(&R);
7719 // TODO: Support strided store.
7720 // TODO: Transform reverse access into strided access with -1 stride.
7721 // TODO: Transform gather/scatter with uniform address into strided access
7722 // with 0 stride.
7723 // TODO: Transform interleave access into multiple strided accesses.
7724 if (!LoadR || LoadR->isConsecutive())
7725 continue;
7726
7727 auto *Ptr = dyn_cast<VPWidenGEPRecipe>(LoadR->getAddr());
7728 if (!Ptr)
7729 continue;
7730
7731 // Check if this is a strided access by analyzing the address SCEV for an
7732 // affine addRec.
7733 const SCEV *PtrSCEV = vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue(Ptr, PSE, &L);
7734 const SCEV *Start;
7735 const SCEVConstant *Step;
7736 // TODO: Support non-constant loop invariant stride.
7737 if (!match(PtrSCEV,
7738 m_scev_AffineAddRec(m_SCEV(Start), m_SCEVConstant(Step),
7739 m_SpecificLoop(&L))))
7740 continue;
7741
7742 Type *LoadTy = LoadR->getScalarType();
7743 Align Alignment = LoadR->getAlign();
7744 auto IsProfitable = [&](ElementCount VF) {
7745 Type *DataTy = toVectorTy(LoadTy, VF);
7746 if (!Ctx.TTI.isLegalStridedLoadStore(DataTy, Alignment))
7747 return false;
7748 const InstructionCost CurrentCost = LoadR->computeCost(VF, Ctx);
7749 const InstructionCost StridedLoadStoreCost =
7750 VPWidenMemIntrinsicRecipe::computeMemIntrinsicCost(
7751 Intrinsic::experimental_vp_strided_load, DataTy,
7752 LoadR->isMasked(), Alignment, Ctx);
7753 return StridedLoadStoreCost < CurrentCost;
7754 };
7755
7756 if (!LoopVectorizationPlanner::getDecisionAndClampRange(IsProfitable,
7757 Range))
7758 continue;
7759
7760 // Invalidate the legacy widening decision so the cost of replaced load is
7761 // not counted during precomputeCosts.
7762 // TODO: Remove once the legacy exit cost computation is retired.
7763 for (ElementCount VF : Range)
7764 Ctx.invalidateWideningDecision(&LoadR->getIngredient(), VF);
7765
7766 // Get VF as i32 for the vector length operand.
7767 if (!I32VF) {
7768 VPBuilder Builder(Plan.getVectorPreheader());
7769 I32VF = Builder.createScalarZExtOrTrunc(
7770 &Plan.getVF(), Type::getInt32Ty(Plan.getContext()),
7771 Plan.getVF().getScalarType(), DebugLoc::getUnknown());
7772 }
7773
7774 VPBuilder Builder(LoadR);
7775 // Create the base pointer of strided access.
7776 // TODO: reuse VPDerivedIVRecipe for base pointer computation when it
7777 // supports a general VPValue as the start value.
7778 VPValue *StartVPV =
7779 VPSCEVExpander(Builder, *PSE.getSE(), LoadR->getDebugLoc())
7780 .tryToExpand(Start);
7781 if (!StartVPV)
7782 StartVPV = VPBuilder(Plan.getEntry()).createExpandSCEV(Start);
7783 VPValue *StrideInBytes = Plan.getOrAddLiveIn(Step->getValue());
7784 Type *IndexTy = Plan.getDataLayout().getIndexType(Ptr->getScalarType());
7785 assert(IndexTy == StrideInBytes->getScalarType() &&
7786 "Stride type from SCEV must match the index type");
7787 VPValue *CanIV = Builder.createScalarZExtOrTrunc(
7788 VectorLoop->getCanonicalIV(), IndexTy,
7789 VectorLoop->getCanonicalIVType(), DebugLoc::getUnknown());
7790 auto *AddRecPtr = cast<SCEVAddRecExpr>(PtrSCEV);
7791 auto *Offset = Builder.createOverflowingOp(
7792 Instruction::Mul, {CanIV, StrideInBytes},
7793 {AddRecPtr->hasNoUnsignedWrap(), /*HasNSW=*/false});
7794 GEPNoWrapFlags NWFlags = AddRecPtr->hasNoUnsignedWrap()
7795 ? GEPNoWrapFlags::noUnsignedWrap()
7796 : GEPNoWrapFlags::none();
7797 VPValue *BasePtr = Builder.createNoWrapPtrAdd(StartVPV, Offset, NWFlags);
7798
7799 // Create a new vector pointer for strided access.
7800 VPValue *NewPtr = Builder.createVectorPointer(
7801 BasePtr, Type::getInt8Ty(Plan.getContext()), StrideInBytes, NWFlags,
7802 Ptr->getDebugLoc());
7803
7804 VPValue *Mask = LoadR->getMask();
7805 if (!Mask)
7806 Mask = Plan.getTrue();
7807 auto *StridedLoad = Builder.createWidenMemIntrinsic(
7808 Intrinsic::experimental_vp_strided_load,
7809 {NewPtr, StrideInBytes, Mask, I32VF}, LoadTy, Alignment, *LoadR,
7810 LoadR->getDebugLoc());
7811 LoadR->replaceAllUsesWith(StridedLoad);
7812 }
7813 }
7814}
